title: Neon search bar to answer, compare and lockup
summary: A search bar glows green on black with light streaks, a question pill lands, dots think, a step-by-step answer card fills in, a two-panel us-vs-them compare holds, then a glowing wordmark, tagline and button close. One shot, 8 s.
use_when: Showing an AI assistant answering one developer question end to end
A short silent teaser for a chatbot or docs assistant on a dark, neon brand
Closing a product tour with a quick ours-vs-others comparison and a start button

look.type_style: geometric sans; UI copy small (about 2 % H) sentence case, white on navy; wordmark bold, sentence case, tight, about 8 % H in bright green; mono for the code line

sfx.event: answer lines and code line fill in
start button appears under the wordmark

structure.shot: empty search bar with a thick green halo on black; thin green light streaks and a curved ribbon sweep diagonally behind it
structure.camera: drift: bar slides right-to-left across frame (centre-right at 0.27 s, left of centre at 1.00 s, centre at 1.27 s), slight zoom ~+4.6 %/s (motion.json second 0)
structure.motion: frame 0 black; bar + halo in by 0.27 s (8 fr@30, ±0.25 s), entrance curve not measurable, suggested easings.outExpo 8 fr; streaks travel linearly corner to corner, easings.linear; whole scene dims out 1.27 to 1.50 s, suggested easings.inOutSine 7 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: user question pill (one line, 7 words, asks how to add a feature) top right in solid green; a faint green radial pool centre; thinking dots on the left
structure.camera: static (pill and pool stay put across cells 6 to 9)
structure.motion: pill present at 1.50 s, entrance under 0.25 s, suggested springs.ui ~10 fr (overshoot not measurable); one dot at 1.77 s, three pulsing dots at 2.00 to 2.27 s (thinking, variant dots); dots gone at 2.50 s

structure.shot: answer card (navy, thin teal border) below the pill: intro line, step 1, a mono code field, step 2, step 3
structure.camera: static, card shifts from centre-right (2.50 to 2.77 s) to centre-left (3.00 s on); motion.json pan 1,8 px/s
structure.motion: card frame in at 2.50 s with intro line only; step 1 + empty code field at 2.77 s; code types in 3.00 to 3.27 s (partial then full) and step 2 appears; step 3 at 3.27 s; holds to 4.27 s. Line reveal per 0.25 s cell, finer stagger not measurable

structure.shot: two side-by-side panels with short labels above (ours, others): left has three grey skeleton lines and a bright glowing button, right has mismatched blocks and an outlined bar
structure.camera: drift: pan ~31 px/s left and zoom ~-2.6 %/s in second 5 (motion.json), then ~-0.8 %/s
structure.motion: pill and card fade as the empty panels fade in over a strong centre glow at 4.50 s; content blocks slide in at 4.77 s (one right-panel block enters from the right edge); settled at 5.00 s, suggested springs.ui ~10 fr (±0.25 s); right-panel outline bar grows from left 5.00 to 5.27 s; hold to 6.27 s

structure.shot: product wordmark in bright green centred inside a teal radial glow; short tagline (4 words, ends in an ellipsis) under it
structure.motion: panels gone and wordmark present at 6.50 s (switch within ±0.25 s, suggested blur-dissolve 6 fr); tagline appears at 6.77 s, suggested easings.outQuint 8 fr

structure.shot: same lockup plus a rounded solid green start button (2 words) under the tagline
structure.motion: button present at 7.27 s, suggested springs.pop ~10 fr (overshoot not measurable); hold 26 fr to the end

params.brand: brand.json with a bright green accent (glow, pill, wordmark, button) on near-black bg and a navy card surface
params.content.question: one user question, 5 to 8 words, shown as a pill
params.content.answer: intro line + 3 numbered steps, one step carries a short code line
params.content.compare: two labels (ours, others) and a description of what each panel shows
params.content.name: product wordmark

notes: One continuous shot, cuts.json lists no cuts, so every row hands over with continuous. Measured from 4 fps sheets only (±0.25 s); all springs, easings and frame counts under 8 fr are suggestions. Reference is silent: sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured. Proposed terms (not in vocabulary): light-streak sweep (row 1), split-compare panels (row 4). The empty bar never shows typing in the sheets: the question appears directly as a pill, so prompt-typing is not claimed. Palette from palettegen on keyframes 0.5/2.5/5.5/7.5 s; the white UI text is not in it.
